Players Committee card image of [[Jakku (Dark) (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E4), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
